A mineral interior / changing optical surface
Thermal type / typography in heated air
Tactile terrain / soft ground and clear intention
Quiet frequency / a playable modular rack
Ember portrait / character in the details
Morph study / a shape for the change
Vector foundry / a line can hold a world
Silver tide / an authored moving surface
A shared rhythm / a living technical diagram
Material laboratory / a precise kind of feeling
A character with a point of view

narrow-dark::split-hero.label: Copy and lamina split
narrow-dark::split-hero.text: Place a compact left-aligned promise and install-sized action beside a tall isometric stack, retaining architectural void, full-height column rails and a small external read-head with a leader line.

narrow-dark::neutral-type-system.label: Neutral sans with mono specimens
narrow-dark::neutral-type-system.text: Set the headline in a large neutral sans and the specimen labels in tiny monospace.

narrow-dark::graphite-white-palette.label: Graphite and cool white palette
narrow-dark::graphite-white-palette.text: Use graphite #0a0c10, cool white faces, near-black undersides and fine blue dimensions.

narrow-dark::isometric-laminae.label: Isometric reference laminae
narrow-dark::isometric-laminae.text: Construct the object as thin reference strata with visible thickness, short edge highlights, occluded gaps and a sharp white top face.

narrow-dark::diagonal-ground-light.label: Diagonal ground light
narrow-dark::diagonal-ground-light.text: Cast the light diagonally across the ground plane.

narrow-dark::travelling-read-head.label: Travelling read-head
narrow-dark::travelling-read-head.text: Move one discrete read-head between strata while its leader, index, kind and swatch update together; reduced motion freezes one complete reading.

pastel-stage::horizon-hero.label: Open horizon hero
pastel-stage::horizon-hero.text: Float one centred typographic statement above a broad low horizon, with a single white rounded command surface beneath it and open sky around the composition.

pastel-stage::spacious-sans.label: Generously spaced medium sans
pastel-stage::spacious-sans.text: Use medium-weight sans typography with generously spaced lines and tiny restrained monospace details.

pastel-stage::lavender-blue-palette.label: Lavender sky and blue ink
pastel-stage::lavender-blue-palette.text: Use near-white lavender #f4f6fb, powder blue and deep blue ink #1b2a50.

pastel-stage::layered-horizon.label: Layered illuminated horizon
pastel-stage::layered-horizon.text: Build a long curved illuminated edge with several quiet atmospheric value layers and fine grain; keep the visual weight in the horizon rim rather than adding cards.

pastel-stage::lifted-command.label: Lifted white command surface
pastel-stage::lifted-command.text: Give the white command surface a crisp upper edge and a soft lift shadow.

pastel-stage::quiet-feedback.label: Stable press confirmation
pastel-stage::quiet-feedback.text: Use brief local press or copy confirmation without changing the button width.

pastel-stage::near-still-atmosphere.label: Near-still atmospheric drift
pastel-stage::near-still-atmosphere.text: Keep the composition complete at rest; any atmospheric drift is nearly imperceptible and stops when hidden.

paper-print::exhibition-mat.label: Paper exhibition mat
paper-print::exhibition-mat.text: Set a large white exhibition mat on warm paper, with a tall narrow title at upper left, specimen metadata in the opposite corner, a saturated printed slab in the lower quarter and a large clean paper interval between them.

paper-print::narrow-editorial-serif.label: Narrow editorial serif
paper-print::narrow-editorial-serif.text: Use Instrument Serif or a similarly narrow editorial serif for the title, balanced by small specimen metadata.

paper-print::warm-print-palette.label: Warm paper and violet ink
paper-print::warm-print-palette.text: Use warm off-white #f3f2ee, charcoal ink and saturated pink-to-violet printed color.

paper-print::bounded-print-artifacts.label: Bounded halftone print slab
paper-print::bounded-print-artifacts.text: Confine a crisp, inspectable halftone region, fine crop marks and registration details to the printed composition rather than applying a noisy full-screen filter.

paper-print::physical-paper.label: Physical paper edges
paper-print::physical-paper.text: Use visible mat edges and subtle print texture to make the sheet read as a physical mounted print.

paper-print::still-print.label: Still print presentation
paper-print::still-print.text: Keep the printed composition still; only the functional action receives short confirmation motion.

dark-atmosphere::beam-centred-hero.label: Centred beam composition
dark-atmosphere::beam-centred-hero.text: Place a concise centred promise across a near-black stage while one broad diagonal beam enters from the upper right and passes behind the copy.

dark-atmosphere::cool-dark-palette.label: Blue-black cyan atmosphere
dark-atmosphere::cool-dark-palette.text: Use blue-black #05070a, cool white type and a restrained cyan cast.

dark-atmosphere::single-volumetric-beam.label: Single volumetric beam
dark-atmosphere::single-volumetric-beam.text: Give one beam a defined edge, long soft falloff, irregular dust density and a plausible off-canvas source; the scene's event is the boundary between illuminated haze and darkness.

dark-atmosphere::rimmed-controls.label: Rim-lit translucent controls
dark-atmosphere::rimmed-controls.text: Use small translucent controls with a lit upper rim.

dark-atmosphere::slow-dust.label: Optional slow dust drift
dark-atmosphere::slow-dust.text: Keep the whole scene present in the still frame; optional dust drifts slowly while text and controls remain fixed, and reading never depends on an entrance sequence.

technical-home::asymmetric-orbit-hero.label: Asymmetric orbital hero
technical-home::asymmetric-orbit-hero.text: Build a very wide black composition with compact left-aligned copy, one large thin orbital object near the centre and a sparse right-hand column of three facts, preserving generous air.

technical-home::two-scale-type.label: Tracked sans and tabular mono
technical-home::two-scale-type.text: Use closely tracked medium sans for the main copy and small tabular monospace for facts, creating two clear scales.

technical-home::black-white-orbit.label: True black and white orbit
technical-home::black-white-orbit.text: Use true black, a very low-contrast complete ring and one white comet arc.

technical-home::sharp-comet-bloom.label: Sharp comet with separate bloom
technical-home::sharp-comet-bloom.text: Separate the comet's fine bright edge from its small bloom so the arc remains sharp while the dark ring remains perceptible.

technical-home::linear-orbit.label: Steady linear orbit
technical-home::linear-orbit.text: Rotate the comet at a steady linear cadence while everything else stays still; pause offscreen and under reduced motion.

ink-air::exposed-grid-page.label: Measured open editorial grid
ink-air::exposed-grid-page.text: Use an almost empty light editorial page where left-aligned type and its action share a precise edge, and expose faint vertical rails, crop crosses and marginal measurements around generous margins.

ink-air::annotated-type.label: Editorial type with mono annotation
ink-air::annotated-type.text: Pair the main reading type with fine monospace construction annotations at comfortable contrast.

ink-air::chalk-graphite-blue.label: Chalk, graphite and blue
ink-air::chalk-graphite-blue.text: Use chalk #fafafa, graphite #3a3a3a and one small blue accent.

ink-air::hairline-scaffold.label: Hairline construction scaffold
ink-air::hairline-scaffold.text: Render the grid as a measured hairline scaffold aligned to the actual columns and gutters, rather than as a background pattern competing with the headline.

ink-air::adaptive-still-grid.label: Still adaptive scaffold
ink-air::adaptive-still-grid.text: Keep the page mostly still; adapt the scaffold exactly to the active breakpoint while keeping press and copy feedback local.

isometric-blueprint::copy-object-split.label: Copy and exploded-document split
isometric-blueprint::copy-object-split.text: Balance a left copy column with a large dimetric exploded document on the right, preserving a shared perspective, external guides and clear air between five parallel sheets.

isometric-blueprint::monochrome-reading-.label: Charcoal with green reading accent
isometric-blueprint::monochrome-reading-.text: Use charcoal #1a1a1c, near-white linework and one minimal green reading accent.

isometric-blueprint::exploded-decision-l.label: Exploded decision-ledger sheets
isometric-blueprint::exploded-decision-l.text: Draw five planes with visible edges, subtle face values and real miniature decision-ledger content, using a consistent line hierarchy from outer silhouette to document structure to annotations.

isometric-blueprint::registered-inspecti.label: Registered sheet inspection
isometric-blueprint::registered-inspecti.text: The object may remain still; any inspection movement must preserve registration between all sheets.

isometric-blueprint::selectable-copy.label: Selectable main-column copy
isometric-blueprint::selectable-copy.text: Keep the text in the main copy column as real selectable DOM text.

emissive-signal::centred-action-slot.label: Centred physical action slot
emissive-signal::centred-action-slot.text: Compose a sparse dark page with centred type and one physical-looking action slot, using a thin amber line beneath it as the only luminous event.

emissive-signal::silver-amber-palette.label: Silver and amber on black
emissive-signal::silver-amber-palette.text: Use near-black #08080a, soft silver type and amber #ffb43c.

emissive-signal::recessed-slot.label: Recessed emissive slot
emissive-signal::recessed-slot.text: Keep the dark recessed surround and physical rim visible around the thin source line.

emissive-signal::local-amber-light.label: Local amber source and halo
emissive-signal::local-amber-light.text: Build a small bright source and a wider low-opacity halo while preserving the line's sharp core; body-copy contrast must remain independent of the glow.

emissive-signal::signal-feedback.label: Local light feedback
emissive-signal::signal-feedback.text: Use local light and label feedback for press and copy actions.

emissive-signal::head-tail-sweep.label: Single-line signal sweep
emissive-signal::head-tail-sweep.text: If a signal sweeps, keep its bright head and softer tail on the same line and stop it at rest.

tactile-instrument::button-as-object.label: Command button as product object
tactile-instrument::button-as-object.text: Centre one oversized command button beneath a short headline on a quiet warm instrument ground.

tactile-instrument::engraved-label.label: Readable engraved label
tactile-instrument::engraved-label.text: Give the monochrome label an engraved appearance while retaining clear legibility.

tactile-instrument::ivory-indicator-pale.label: Ivory with signal indicator
tactile-instrument::ivory-indicator-pale.text: Use warm ivory #f2f1ee, graphite and a tiny orange or green indicator.

tactile-instrument::machined-button.label: Machined layered command
tactile-instrument::machined-button.text: Construct a machined outer bezel, recessed track, raised cap, separate indicator window and small fasteners, with visible thickness, inset shadow, edge bevels and directional highlights.

tactile-instrument::depressing-cap.label: Short cap depression
tactile-instrument::depressing-cap.text: Depress the cap slightly on press while preserving the button's dimensions through every state.

tactile-instrument::honest-copy-state.label: Honest copy indicator
tactile-instrument::honest-copy-state.text: On successful copy, update the indicator and an accessible status; never display success after a failed copy.

divider-trio::shared-border-trio.label: Shared-border feature plates
divider-trio::shared-border-trio.text: Join three adjacent feature plates with one continuous outline and single shared dividers. Each plate contains a FIG number, explanatory drawing, short title, paragraph and compact specification list.

divider-trio::silver-technical-type.label: Silver technical hierarchy
divider-trio::silver-technical-type.text: Use crisp silver typography with small monospace FIG labels and specification indices against the dark surface.

divider-trio::near-black-linework.label: Near-black grayscale plates
divider-trio::near-black-linework.text: Use a nearly black surface, crisp silver text and fine gray line drawings, reserving any small signal color for meaning.

divider-trio::literal-feature-drawings.label: Literal technical feature drawings
divider-trio::literal-feature-drawings.text: Use one coherent calibrated line grammar for three distinct subjects: branching source files, weighted input distribution and a decision ledger. Crosshairs and line terminals must describe actual relationships.

divider-trio::explanatory-line-motion.label: Explanatory line motion
divider-trio::explanatory-line-motion.text: A subtle packet or line draw may explain a connection, but every illustration remains complete at rest and repeated demonstrations yield to deliberate interaction.

pebble-trio::dissolving-feature-trio.label: Dissolving feature trio
pebble-trio::dissolving-feature-trio.text: Arrange three pale feature scenes whose image areas dissolve into their text areas, using floating fragments to show a layered ledger, a two-way concept diagram and a plotted timing curve.

pebble-trio::periwinkle-neutral-palette.label: Periwinkle and milky white
pebble-trio::periwinkle-neutral-palette.text: Use pale periwinkle, milky white, blue-gray labels and restrained semantic accents.

pebble-trio::layered-ui-fragments.label: Layered instrument fragments
pebble-trio::layered-ui-fragments.text: Place fine-content fragments on multiple planes with slight translucency, giving each scene a specific explanatory drawing rather than a generic gradient rectangle.

pebble-trio::buoyant-surfaces.label: Buoyant translucent surfaces
pebble-trio::buoyant-surfaces.text: Use soft contact shadows and light translucency to make white fragments buoyant without generic giant drop shadows.

pebble-trio::shared-directional-light.label: Shared directional light
pebble-trio::shared-directional-light.text: Light all three scenes from one consistent direction.

pebble-trio::contained-scene-motion.label: Contained instrument motion
pebble-trio::contained-scene-motion.text: If used, keep tiny plotted runners or floating motion inside the scenes while descriptive text remains still; every scene retains a strong composed frame.

print-ledger::twelve-row-sheet.label: Twelve-row ledger sheet
print-ledger::twelve-row-sheet.text: Frame a sheet containing twelve aligned rows, with a narrow title, small document metadata, row numbers, dotted leaders, a right-aligned value column and a thin print band closing the sheet.

print-ledger::serif-mono-ledger.label: Serif title and tabular values
print-ledger::serif-mono-ledger.text: Use a narrow serif title, small metadata, faded row indices and tabular monospace values, with exact baseline and final-digit alignment.

print-ledger::paper-red-palette.label: Warm paper and faded red
print-ledger::paper-red-palette.text: Use warm gray board, white paper, charcoal text and faded red row numbers.

print-ledger::leader-and-halftone-detail.label: Dotted leaders and minute halftone
print-ledger::leader-and-halftone-detail.text: Keep dotted-leader density exact and confine minute halftone detail to the print treatment.

print-ledger::paper-edge-depth.label: Subtle paper-edge depth
print-ledger::paper-edge-depth.text: Let subtle paper edges provide the physical depth.

print-ledger::still-qualified-data.label: Still qualified reading surface
print-ledger::still-qualified-data.text: Keep the ledger primarily still and retain any sample or historical-data label at every breakpoint.

mosaic-gallery::specimen-grid.label: Eight-plate specimen gallery
mosaic-gallery::specimen-grid.text: Arrange eight compact specimen plates as a disciplined 4-by-2 gallery over one wide processed chromatic field; each plate contains an index, compact palette, family name and one contextual note.

mosaic-gallery::compact-neutral-labels.label: Compact neutral specimen labels
mosaic-gallery::compact-neutral-labels.text: Keep every plate's index, family name and note compact, neutral and readable over the field.

mosaic-gallery::shared-chroma-field.label: Shared violet-ochre chroma field
mosaic-gallery::shared-chroma-field.text: Use one luminous field spanning violet, ochre, pink and blue behind dark translucent plates; keep swatches crisp and opaque rather than giving every card an independent gradient.

mosaic-gallery::two-scale-pixel-texture.label: Two-scale pixel texture
mosaic-gallery::two-scale-pixel-texture.text: Combine coarse field pixels with finer grain to create two inspectable scales of detail.

mosaic-gallery::quiet-gallery.label: Quiet readable gallery
mosaic-gallery::quiet-gallery.text: Keep the background quiet and the plates fixed for reading; on mobile reflow to two columns without losing a specimen.

emissive-metrics::matrix-with-label-colu.label: Labelled dot-matrix region
emissive-metrics::matrix-with-label-colu.text: Give a bespoke dot-matrix chart one deliberate region of a dark canvas, with family names in a fixed left column, discrete data points in the centre and tabular totals aligned at right amid generous surrounding air.

emissive-metrics::compact-data-type.label: Compact tabular data type
emissive-metrics::compact-data-type.text: Use compact labels and tabular monospace totals with enough measure for the longest family name.

emissive-metrics::cool-blue-emission.label: Cool blue evidence points
emissive-metrics::cool-blue-emission.text: Use near-black, low-contrast guide structure and cool blue active points whose crisp central pixels remain brighter than their small blooms.

emissive-metrics::encoded-dot-counts.label: Discrete reconciled dot counts
emissive-metrics::encoded-dot-counts.text: Encode values as discrete lit dots and ensure every dot count reconciles with its displayed total.

emissive-metrics::stable-data.label: Stable readable values
emissive-metrics::stable-data.text: Data may appear once or remain still, but values being read never drift.

emissive-metrics::accessible-data-equiva.label: Readable data equivalent
emissive-metrics::accessible-data-equiva.text: Provide the same information as accessible readable text.

frozen-interaction::weighted-choice-frag.label: Weighted choice fragment
frozen-interaction::weighted-choice-frag.text: Centre one compact dark product fragment containing a quiet question title bar, four aligned choice rows and a final total; each row pairs a selection control, name and numeric share.

frozen-interaction::question-to-total-hi.label: Question-to-total hierarchy
frozen-interaction::question-to-total-hi.text: Order the typographic hierarchy as question, selected rows, numeric total and then metadata.

frozen-interaction::violet-lilac-palette.label: Violet-black and muted lilac
frozen-interaction::violet-lilac-palette.text: Use a violet-black ground, muted lilac selection fill and small luminous ticks.

frozen-interaction::inset-choice-surface.label: Inset divided choice surface
frozen-interaction::inset-choice-surface.text: Place the choices on a slightly lifted dark surface with a restrained inset border and fine row dividers.

frozen-interaction::operable-weighted-ch.label: Operable weighted choices
frozen-interaction::operable-weighted-ch.text: When used as product UI, make weighted choices operable, maintain a total of 100 and expose every value accessibly.

chapters::rail-and-panel.label: Chapter rail and detail panel
chapters::rail-and-panel.text: Place a narrow numbered chapter rail beside one spacious detail panel. Give the active item a tiny registration line and keep panel title, prose and a short evidence list in one stable layout.

chapters::mono-index-sans-detail.label: Mono indices with calm sans detail
chapters::mono-index-sans-detail.text: Use muted monospace indices in the rail and graphite reading typography in the detail panel.

chapters::white-graphite-blue.label: White, graphite and blue registration
chapters::white-graphite-blue.text: Use an almost-white ground, white panel, graphite typography and one muted blue registration accent.

chapters::restrained-panel-depth.label: Restrained raised panel
chapters::restrained-panel-depth.text: Give the focal panel a restrained radius, broad faint elevation shadow and crisp surface edge without turning the whole page into a panel.

chapters::chapter-selection.label: Unified chapter selection
chapters::chapter-selection.text: Support click, keyboard focus and activation, and touch as equivalent ways to select a chapter; rapid selections resolve to the latest choice.

chapters::brief-panel-dissolve.label: Brief in-place dissolve
chapters::brief-panel-dissolve.text: Swap the panel in place with a brief dissolve. Any auto-demo stops after user input and under reduced motion.

outlined-bento::two-by-two-bento.label: Two-by-two evidence bento
outlined-bento::two-by-two-bento.text: Arrange four dark outlined feature surfaces in a 2-by-2 grid, placing each feature's copy beside or beneath its own visual evidence.

outlined-bento::neutral-dark-type.label: Neutral dark feature type
outlined-bento::neutral-dark-type.text: Use neutral gray typography with a clear hierarchy against graphite surfaces.

outlined-bento::graphite-signal-palette.label: Graphite with one lit signal
outlined-bento::graphite-signal-palette.text: Use a black ground, graphite surfaces, fine calibrated strokes and one small lit signal; one plate may lead in contrast while all content stays readable.

outlined-bento::four-technical-subjects.label: Four distinct technical subjects
outlined-bento::four-technical-subjects.text: Give the plates distinct explanatory visuals: branching concept paths, a framed scroll strip, a plotted motion curve and a resolved state change.

outlined-bento::tight-rimmed-surfaces.label: Tight rimmed dark surfaces
outlined-bento::tight-rimmed-surfaces.text: Use tight radii, uniform quiet borders and restrained directional rim highlights without drop shadows.

outlined-bento::evidence-first-motion.label: Evidence-first plate motion
outlined-bento::evidence-first-motion.text: Use motion only to explain a feature within its plate; retain a complete still frame and never require hover or focus to discover the evidence.

instrument-hud::semicircular-instrument.label: Centred semicircular instrument
instrument-hud::semicircular-instrument.text: Centre a calibrated semicircular instrument on a fine dark engineering grid, placing a large numeric reading inside the arc with a small unit label and compact secondary readout row.

instrument-hud::tabular-hud-type.label: Tabular HUD readout
instrument-hud::tabular-hud-type.text: Use tabular monospace for the main value, unit and secondary readings.

instrument-hud::black-green-amber.label: Black-green and amber scale
instrument-hud::black-green-amber.text: Use black-green #040607, warm amber #ffb43c and dim machined gray.

instrument-hud::ranked-gauge-marks.label: Ranked calibrated gauge
instrument-hud::ranked-gauge-marks.text: Build thick and thin tick ranks, an inner hairline arc and an exact lit-segment endpoint around the named scale.

instrument-hud::concentrated-amber-glow.label: Concentrated amber glow
instrument-hud::concentrated-amber-glow.text: Concentrate the amber glow around lit evidence while preserving a dark core inside the light.

instrument-hud::single-source-value.label: Single-source gauge value
instrument-hud::single-source-value.text: Generate the lit tick count, displayed value and accessible description from one explicitly named quantity and scale.

paper-slips::handled-paper-trio.label: Handled revision-slip trio
paper-slips::handled-paper-trio.text: Rest three small paper documents on a warm desk-like ground, using slight rotation differences and offset crop corners; each contains a revision code, narrow title and short note.

paper-slips::serif-revision-type.label: Narrow revision-slip serif
paper-slips::serif-revision-type.text: Set each slip's title in a narrow serif and keep its revision code and note clearly readable.

paper-slips::cream-gold-ink.label: Cream, gold and charcoal
paper-slips::cream-gold-ink.text: Use warm cream #f2efe8, ivory sheets, muted gold registration marks and charcoal ink.

paper-slips::lifted-paper.label: Lifted paper corners
paper-slips::lifted-paper.text: Model a subtle lifted corner, fine outer edge and soft directional contact shadow on the paper, keeping texture secondary to type.

paper-slips::still-editorial-arrangement.label: Still editorial arrangement
paper-slips::still-editorial-arrangement.text: Keep the arrangement still and retain all three slips at narrow widths rather than removing one to fit a poster height.

editorial-close::distant-seam-closing.label: Distant-seam closing composition
editorial-close::distant-seam-closing.text: Place an emphatic centred closing statement above a small command action, with a very fine light seam much lower in the frame and sparse aligned metadata completing the composition.

editorial-close::large-neutral-statement.label: Large neutral closing type
editorial-close::large-neutral-statement.text: Make large neutral sans typography the primary visual object.

editorial-close::blue-black-electric-sea.label: Blue-black with electric seam
editorial-close::blue-black-electric-sea.text: Use blue-black, soft white and one electric-blue seam.

editorial-close::feathered-seam-light.label: Feathered seam reflection
editorial-close::feathered-seam-light.text: Give the seam a restrained halo and a long feathered reflection that adds depth without filling the empty stage with shapes.

editorial-close::still-ending-feedback.label: Still ending with local feedback
editorial-close::still-ending-feedback.text: Hold the composition still and give the action immediate local feedback; understanding must not depend on a long reveal.

proof-diptych::equal-evidence-diptych.label: Equal-space evidence diptych
proof-diptych::equal-evidence-diptych.text: Give two visual treatments equal image space beneath one short shared title, supported by a fine divider, restrained captions and a visible source or context note.

proof-diptych::silver-comparison-type.label: Silver sans with mono captions
proof-diptych::silver-comparison-type.text: Use silver sans typography for the shared title and restrained tabular monospace for comparison captions.

proof-diptych::blue-divided-dark.label: Near-black with blue divider
proof-diptych::blue-divided-dark.text: Use a near-black ground, silver text and one thin blue divider, letting the detailed evidence inside the frames provide texture and complexity.

proof-diptych::aligned-comparison-images.label: Aligned before-and-after evidence
proof-diptych::aligned-comparison-images.text: Use actual detailed comparison images aligned to the same content, and keep both sides fully visible rather than dimming evidence for an effect.

proof-diptych::optional-comparison-revea.label: Keyboard-operable comparison reveal
proof-diptych::optional-comparison-revea.text: Offer a reveal control only when true before and after images exist, and make it keyboard operable; otherwise present the available composite as a static diptych.

correction-ledger::numbered-correction-l.label: Numbered correction ledger
correction-ledger::numbered-correction-l.text: Build an editorial paper ledger from numbered lines, a narrow headline and a small contextual footer framing the list.

correction-ledger::serif-mono-review-typ.label: Humane serif with mono indices
correction-ledger::serif-mono-review-typ.text: Pair a narrow humane serif headline with small monospace row indices and readable ledger copy.

correction-ledger::paper-graphite-red.label: Warm paper and faded red ink
correction-ledger::paper-graphite-red.text: Use warm off-white paper, muted graphite, faded red ink and fine horizontal rules.

correction-ledger::precise-correction-st.label: Text-aligned correction strikes
correction-ledger::precise-correction-st.text: Align one thin red strike to each corrected phrase instead of placing a large bar through an entire row.

correction-ledger::still-review-record.label: Still readable review record
correction-ledger::still-review-record.text: Keep the correction list still and continuously readable.

two-registers::paired-motion-tracks.label: Paired calibrated motion tracks
two-registers::paired-motion-tracks.text: Stack two horizontal calibrated tracks, with purpose and timing labels above each and a short note explaining their difference.

two-registers::tabular-timing-labels.label: Restrained tabular timing labels
two-registers::tabular-timing-labels.text: Use restrained tabular monospace for track names, durations, tick labels and the explanatory note.

two-registers::green-white-signals.label: Green and white motion signals
two-registers::green-white-signals.text: Use graphite-black, a green signal for steady motion and a white signal for the responsive transition.

two-registers::oscilloscope-tracks.label: Oscilloscope-like calibrated tracks
two-registers::oscilloscope-tracks.text: Construct fine vertical ticks around a sharp moving centre and a soft local halo, preserving a meaningful resting position in every track.

two-registers::steady-and-responsive-reg.label: Steady and responsive motion registers
two-registers::steady-and-responsive-reg.text: Loop the steady example linearly; let the responsive example traverse, decelerate and hold. Present them as two useful examples rather than a complete taxonomy of motion.

two-registers::pausable-demonstrations.label: Pausable visible demonstrations
two-registers::pausable-demonstrations.text: Provide a visible pause action, pause when hidden and replace movement with meaningful composed positions under reduced motion.

stop-conditions::dial-and-condition-list.label: Dial with four stop conditions
stop-conditions::dial-and-condition-list.text: Balance a large ivory rotary instrument on a fine dot grid with a concise list of four selectable conditions; open one useful explanation for the active row.

stop-conditions::quiet-instrument-type.label: Quiet instrument labels
stop-conditions::quiet-instrument-type.text: Keep labels and descriptions quieter than the physical object while retaining clear active, focus and long-description states.

stop-conditions::ivory-graphite-orange.label: Ivory, graphite and orange marks
stop-conditions::ivory-graphite-orange.text: Use warm ivory, graphite and tiny orange marks to carry the active instrument state.

stop-conditions::bevelled-detent-dial.label: Bevelled detent dial
stop-conditions::bevelled-detent-dial.text: Build a softly recessed circular face from concentric bevel rings, radial ticks, a short raised pointer and a grounded shadow.

stop-conditions::settling-detent-pointer.label: Settling detent pointer
stop-conditions::settling-detent-pointer.text: Turn the pointer to the selected detent with a restrained settling transition; reduced motion changes to the composed result immediately.

stop-conditions::user-stopped-cycling.label: User-stopped scripted cycling
stop-conditions::user-stopped-cycling.text: Make all four rows real buttons that update pointer and description together, and stop scripted cycling as soon as the user selects anything.

reference-contact-sheet::archival-specim.label: Complete archival specimen grid
reference-contact-sheet::archival-specim.text: Arrange many tiny specimens as a meticulously spaced contact sheet beneath a narrow heading and beside a compact fill legend.

reference-contact-sheet::serif-heading-l.label: Narrow serif with compact legend
reference-contact-sheet::serif-heading-l.text: Use a narrow editorial serif for the collection heading and compact, readable labels for the specimen legend and archive metadata.

reference-contact-sheet::cream-black-mod.label: Cream paper and mode-coded fills
reference-contact-sheet::cream-black-mod.text: Use cream paper and black ink, with restrained fill variation encoding light, dark and mixed source modes.

reference-contact-sheet::print-scale-spe.label: Print-scale specimen marks
reference-contact-sheet::print-scale-spe.text: Give every tile a subtle ruled border, inset neutral mark and fine registration texture that remains coherent at print scale.

reference-contact-sheet::quiet-grid-scan.label: Quiet contact-sheet scan
reference-contact-sheet::quiet-grid-scan.text: If motion is used, let one very quiet scanning band traverse the fixed grid; never animate individual tiles as a wave.

blend-matrix::matrix-and-reading-panel.label: Eight-by-eight matrix and detail panel
blend-matrix::matrix-and-reading-panel.text: Balance an eight-by-eight labelled decision matrix with one stable detail-reading panel.

blend-matrix::orthogonal-matrix-labels.label: Orthogonal matrix labels
blend-matrix::orthogonal-matrix-labels.text: Set column labels vertically, row labels horizontally and the detail explanation in a calm readable measure.

blend-matrix::blue-red-matrix-signals.label: Blue and red matrix signals
blend-matrix::blue-red-matrix-signals.text: Use blue-black, very thin square cells, small blue positive marks, muted red tension marks and one exact bright focus outline.

blend-matrix::three-state-pairing-marks.label: Three-state pairing marks
blend-matrix::three-state-pairing-marks.text: Distinguish documented pairings, combinations needing deliberate reconciliation and unassessed pairs with three clearly different marks.

blend-matrix::equivalent-cell-inspection.label: Equivalent matrix inspection
blend-matrix::equivalent-cell-inspection.text: Make hover, focus and tap reveal the same named pairing detail; use roving arrow-key focus inside the matrix and keep those keys from driving the page carousel.

example-run::single-terminal-story.label: Single terminal workflow story
example-run::single-terminal-story.text: Float one carefully proportioned terminal window in a dark stage, using a narrow title bar and a readable sequence of command, observation, decision and output lines.

example-run::tabular-terminal-type.label: Readable tabular terminal type
example-run::tabular-terminal-type.text: Set meaningful terminal lines in a clear tabular monospace with consistent indentation and enough line height for a short workflow story.

example-run::graphite-mint-terminal.label: Graphite terminal with mint status
example-run::graphite-mint-terminal.text: Use an almost-black outer field, slightly lifted graphite terminal, tiny muted window dots and mint status words.

example-run::framed-terminal-depth.label: Crisp lifted terminal frame
example-run::framed-terminal-depth.text: Give the terminal a crisp frame and deep broad shadow, deriving texture from meaningful lines rather than dense random code.

example-run::brief-line-sequence.label: Brief terminal line sequence
example-run::brief-line-sequence.text: Reveal complete lines in a short readable sequence, hold the final result and provide replay only when it helps.

agent-integrations::manifesto-and-opposi.label: Manifesto with opposing name belts
agent-integrations::manifesto-and-opposi.text: Place a spacious left-aligned manifesto above two opposing belts of compact compatibility names that extend toward the edges through quiet fade masks.

agent-integrations::comfortable-chip-typ.label: Comfortable compatibility labels
agent-integrations::comfortable-chip-typ.text: Use comfortable sans typography and crisp small symbols so every compatibility name remains easy to read.

agent-integrations::white-graphite-shell.label: Almost-white graphite shell
agent-integrations::white-graphite-shell.text: Use an almost-white ground, graphite text and white chips with very fine neutral borders.

agent-integrations::tangible-name-chips.label: Tangible bordered name chips
agent-integrations::tangible-name-chips.text: Give the pill-shaped chips fine borders and soft shadows without turning the surface into a wall of logos.

agent-integrations::seamless-name-belts.label: Seamless modest name belts
agent-integrations::seamless-name-belts.text: Move the belts at a steady modest speed using seamless duplication and quiet edge fades.

agent-integrations::pausable-static-fall.label: Pausable wrapped fallback
agent-integrations::pausable-static-fall.text: Pause movement on hover, focus or an explicit action; under reduced motion show a readable wrapped set of unique items and hide visual duplicates from assistive technology.

measured-page::seven-container-compariso.label: Seven measured container rows
measured-page::seven-container-compariso.text: Compare seven historical page containers as aligned dimension rows, each carrying a name, precise horizontal measure and tabular value; emphasize one chosen specimen in blue.

measured-page::restrained-specification-.label: Restrained specification type
measured-page::restrained-specification-.text: Use a restrained heading, compact source note and tabular values aligned for quick comparison.

measured-page::white-graphite-drafting-b.label: White, graphite and drafting blue
measured-page::white-graphite-drafting-b.text: Use a white sheet, graphite text and one drafting-blue emphasis.

measured-page::scaled-dimension-lines.label: Scaled dimension-line comparison
measured-page::scaled-dimension-lines.text: Draw fine horizontal measures with endpoint ticks and subtle rulers, using the longest documented chain as the visual scale and labelling any truncated axis.

measured-page::still-measuring-view.label: Still scannable measures
measured-page::still-measuring-view.text: Keep the measuring view still and scannable.

light-dark::paired-theme-evidence.label: Paired light and dark evidence
light-dark::paired-theme-evidence.text: Surround a compact list of four material criteria with two comparable product previews that share content structure while independently composing surface hierarchy and light.

light-dark::stable-criteria-hierarchy.label: Stable criteria hierarchy
light-dark::stable-criteria-hierarchy.text: Keep criterion labels and one stable explanation in a consistent hierarchy across all selected states.

light-dark::independent-theme-neutrals.label: Independent light and dark neutrals
light-dark::independent-theme-neutrals.text: Use opaque whites and tuned neutral values in light mode, and graphite planes with adjusted luminous edges in dark mode; keep accent semantics consistent while tuning luminance per theme.

light-dark::theme-specific-separation.label: Theme-specific separation materials
light-dark::theme-specific-separation.text: Separate light planes with soft contact shadows and dark planes with tonal steps and subtle edges, re-deriving the material treatment for each mode.

light-dark::paired-criterion-inspection.label: Paired criterion inspection
light-dark::paired-criterion-inspection.text: Selecting separation, accent, imagery or depth emphasizes corresponding evidence on both sides and updates one stable explanation; keyboard and touch expose the same states.

scenic-close::invitation-over-landscape.label: Invitation above panoramic landscape
scenic-close::invitation-over-landscape.text: Build a spacious closing section with a short large invitation at upper left, two quiet next actions at right and a panoramic landscape filling the lower half to the bottom edge.

scenic-close::editorial-serif-ending.label: Editorial serif closing voice
scenic-close::editorial-serif-ending.text: Use editorial serif type for the invitation and supporting navigation, keeping links as real text outside the illustration.

scenic-close::cream-and-blue-ink.label: Cream paper and blue ink
scenic-close::cream-and-blue-ink.text: Use one family of dark blue ink on cream paper, retaining cream gaps inside the drawing as structural highlights.

scenic-close::inhabited-engraved-panoram.label: Inhabited engraved panorama
scenic-close::inhabited-engraved-panoram.text: Author a connected landscape of house, trees, paths, shoreline and water with varied line density, a distinct distant layer and enough workmanship to reward close inspection.

scenic-close::static-illustrated-closing.label: Static illustrated closing
scenic-close::static-illustrated-closing.text: Keep the landscape still; no parallax, water motion or scroll reveal is implied by the source.

scenic-close::functional-closing-actions.label: Functional closing actions
scenic-close::functional-closing-actions.text: Keep both next actions functional and place copy feedback beside the action that caused it.

warm-choices::three-illustrated-choices.label: Three substantial onboarding choices
warm-choices::three-illustrated-choices.text: Place three substantial onboarding choice cards beneath a short welcoming heading and compact mode selector; give each a title, clear promise, concise checklist and choice action, with a small character peeking over the row.

warm-choices::warm-editorial-choice-type.label: Warm editorial choice hierarchy
warm-choices::warm-editorial-choice-type.text: Use dark brown editorial type with a concise, clearly stepped hierarchy from welcome to title, promise, checklist and action.

warm-choices::ivory-burgundy-pink.label: Ivory, burgundy and warm pink
warm-choices::ivory-burgundy-pink.text: Use warm ivory and burgundy with carefully tuned pink and cream surfaces.

warm-choices::peeking-clay-bird.label: Peeking clay bird character
warm-choices::peeking-clay-bird.text: Use a small original bird with clay-like volume, eyes, feathers and a grounded overlap at the top of the choice row; keep it supporting rather than dominant.

warm-choices::restrained-warm-cards.label: Restrained warm card surfaces
warm-choices::restrained-warm-cards.text: Give the cards fine borders, controlled corner radii and barely lifted downward shadows, using small warm tonal steps rather than a strong border.

warm-choices::coherent-choice-state.label: Coherent Explore, Specify, Build states
warm-choices::coherent-choice-state.text: Make Explore, Specify and Build real keyboard- and touch-operable choices. The chosen card reads through a distinct warm surface, label and action, and updates title, explanation and outcome together without moving the whole layout.

character-close::character-anchored-clos.label: Character-anchored closing page
character-close::character-anchored-clos.text: Anchor a warm closing page with one oversized friendly character, balanced by large editorial words, generous open space and compact useful next actions rather than decorative cards.

character-close::serif-sans-closing-voic.label: Humane serif with clear controls
character-close::serif-sans-closing-voic.text: Mix humane serif emphasis with clear sans controls, keeping the closing words spacious and the actions concise.

character-close::cream-olive-muted-red.label: Cream, olive and muted red
character-close::cream-olive-muted-red.text: Use cream, olive and muted red accents, keeping the interface quiet enough for the illustrated character to carry the color.

character-close::sculptural-character.label: Sculptural character with point of view
character-close::sculptural-character.text: Create an original character with rounded volumes, deliberate pose and tiny face and edge details; personality must come from proportion and posture rather than an emoji-like blob.

character-close::grounded-tactile-charac.label: Grounded tactile character
character-close::grounded-tactile-charac.text: Give the character tactile modeled surfaces and a soft contact shadow that places it on the page rather than inside a card.

character-close::asset-only-character-mo.label: Asset-only character motion
character-close::asset-only-character-mo.text: If the character moves, preserve its silhouette and keep all reading text still; a one-way state change plays once and holds rather than jumping back into a loop.

character-close::honest-closing-actions.label: Honest closing actions
character-close::honest-closing-actions.text: Let closing actions download a starting brief or copy an install command, and report each result accurately beside its control.

arch-editorial::monumental-heading-friez.label: Monumental heading over image frieze
arch-editorial::monumental-heading-friez.text: Place a monumental single-word serif heading above a seven-strip frieze, balancing it with a short editorial note and small Change the view action on the quieter side.

arch-editorial::cultivated-spacious-type.label: Cultivated spacious editorial type
arch-editorial::cultivated-spacious-type.text: Use cultivated spacious serif display type with calm supporting copy rather than dashboard typography.

arch-editorial::warm-ink-rich-imagery.label: Warm ground with bounded imagery
arch-editorial::warm-ink-rich-imagery.text: Use a warm light ground and dark ink, letting rich bounded imagery provide the chroma and depth.

arch-editorial::varied-arch-strips.label: Varied architectural arch strips
arch-editorial::varied-arch-strips.text: Build seven tall narrow strips with coherent proportions and a deliberate rhythm of full arches, one-shoulder curves and square tops.

arch-editorial::curated-material-crops.label: Curated material crop sequence
arch-editorial::curated-material-crops.text: Fill the frieze with intentional crops of folded paper, organic green texture and warm material, preserving distinct focal subjects and complementary visual weight.

arch-editorial::stable-view-selection.label: Stable Change the view selection
arch-editorial::stable-view-selection.text: Change the active view and its description together while retaining a stable reading anchor across input methods and narrow-screen reflow.

kinetic-collection::protected-type-among.label: Protected type amid image collection
kinetic-collection::protected-type-among.text: Place large readable type in a protected central zone while a curated collection of image cards occupies the surrounding field with varied size, rotation, depth order and generous intervals.

kinetic-collection::dominant-editorial-a.label: Dominant editorial reading anchor
kinetic-collection::dominant-editorial-a.text: Keep the central type stronger than every individual image card and protect the heading, action and header throughout the composition.

kinetic-collection::neutral-shell-image-.label: Neutral shell with image-led color
kinetic-collection::neutral-shell-image-.text: Use warm near-white and graphite for the interface while richly rendered objects and illustrations carry the collection's color.

kinetic-collection::varied-curated-image.label: Varied curated image cards
kinetic-collection::varied-curated-image.text: Give every card distinct material or imagery and establish an authored sequence of subject, crop, scale and overlap rather than scattering arbitrary rectangles.

kinetic-collection::thin-layered-cards.label: Thin layered image cards
kinetic-collection::thin-layered-cards.text: Use crisp card edges, subtle thickness, small shadows and controlled overlaps to establish front-to-back order.

kinetic-collection::bounded-image-drift.label: Bounded slow image drift
kinetic-collection::bounded-image-drift.text: Animate image transforms slowly inside a tested envelope while type and actions remain fixed; reduced motion holds an intentional authored arrangement.

kinetic-collection::pausable-collection.label: Pausable kinetic collection
kinetic-collection::pausable-collection.text: Provide a pause action and recompose the collection for portrait screens without losing the central reading zone.

action-result::split-workflow.label: Action and result split
action-result::split-workflow.text: Use a dark split onboarding surface with a concise project-name and tone form beside a large persistent live preview. Controls and output form one continuous story rather than unrelated cards.

action-result::complete-miniature.label: Complete miniature preview
action-result::complete-miniature.text: Render an actual miniature brand header, typographic hero, detailed metal aperture image and footer. Use composed editorial hierarchy and a small original visual rather than skeleton bars alone.

action-result::graphite-palette.label: Graphite with a brighter result
action-result::graphite-palette.text: Use near-black and graphite planes with subtle divider lines, quiet metadata and a clearly brighter preview surface.

action-result::quiet-sans.label: Clean quiet sans
action-result::quiet-sans.text: Use clean sans typography with restrained metadata and a real editorial type hierarchy inside the preview.

action-result::live-direction-update.label: Live direction consequence
action-result::live-direction-update.text: Editing the project name and selecting Quiet, Warm or Bold updates the actual preview, type treatment, palette and explanatory text. The submit action confirms the current direction; inputs remain stable and keyboard operation does not trigger page navigation.

pixel-plan::split-choice-page.label: Editorial choice split
pixel-plan::split-choice-page.text: Use a split light onboarding page: an editorial heading and small tangible paper stack on the left, with a substantial rounded choice card on the right. Crown the card with a luminous jade object before its options and outcome.

pixel-plan::forest-interface-type.label: Readable forest interface type
pixel-plan::forest-interface-type.text: Use dark forest ink with readable option descriptions and concise outcome copy.

pixel-plan::mint-paper-palette.label: Mint, paper and forest
pixel-plan::mint-paper-palette.text: Use mint, warm white, dark forest ink and pale jade glass, with a strong dark-green action.

pixel-plan::jade-and-paper-material.label: Luminous jade and crisp paper
pixel-plan::jade-and-paper-material.text: Give the jade object apparent thickness, caustic-like internal light and a soft shadow. Give the paper sheets crisp edges, offset depth and fine print.

pixel-plan::depth-choice-control.label: Three consequential depth choices
pixel-plan::depth-choice-control.text: Three depth choices update the outcome text, radio state and confirmation. Arrow keys, touch and pointer work consistently; the decorative object can remain still.

rolling-decisions::three-weight-layout.label: Three dominant weighted values
rolling-decisions::three-weight-layout.text: Let three very large numerical shares dominate a dark editorial page. Pair each number with a short label, slider and concise explanation, then reconcile them below with a segmented total bar and a few presets.

rolling-decisions::rolling-numerals.label: Clipped rolling numerals
rolling-decisions::rolling-numerals.text: Set soft-ivory numerals in individually clipped rolling windows with tabular alignment. The page should read as typography in motion rather than a dashboard of small metric cards.

rolling-decisions::black-green-sage.label: Black-green and sage
rolling-decisions::black-green-sage.text: Use black-green #0c1010, soft ivory numerals and restrained sage accents.

rolling-decisions::digit-wheel-motion.label: Value-bound digit wheels
rolling-decisions::digit-wheel-motion.text: Animate individual digit wheels while the accessible numeric values update immediately. Reduced motion changes digits without rolling.

rolling-decisions::balanced-weight-contr.label: Always-balanced weights
rolling-decisions::balanced-weight-contr.text: Adjusting one weight redistributes the remainder so the total stays exactly 100. Presets set all three shares coherently.

menu-preview::menu-and-preview.label: Adjacent consequence preview
menu-preview::menu-and-preview.text: Lead with a light editorial intro, then place a small source control and compact menu beside a larger stable preview. Hover, focus or selection reveals an option's consequence before commitment.

menu-preview::miniature-page-graphics.label: Architectural paper miniature
menu-preview::miniature-page-graphics.text: Make the hero preview a real miniature page with a browser rim, protected text column and one original architectural paper sculpture. Preserve consistent perspective, folded edge thickness, grounded shadow, negative space and composed type-to-art scale.

menu-preview::warm-sage-palette.label: Warm paper and sage planes
menu-preview::warm-sage-palette.text: Use warm white #f8f7f2, forest-gray ink, quiet green selection, sage structural planes, ivory folded paper and one restrained ochre accent.

menu-preview::descriptive-menu-rows.label: Descriptive menu rows
menu-preview::descriptive-menu-rows.text: Give each menu row a distinct miniature composition icon, short descriptive text and a small arrow. Keep the labels understandable at delivered size.

menu-preview::preview-selection.label: Keyboard-equivalent preview selection
menu-preview::preview-selection.text: Hero, feature and onboarding options produce different preview layouts. Support pointer input, roving keyboard selection, Escape close and focus return without changing menu width or desynchronizing preview state.

working-widgets::unequal-widget-grid.label: Aligned unequal workbench
working-widgets::unequal-widget-grid.text: Arrange four unequal but aligned light widgets beneath a large editorial heading: note paper, a contrast specimen, a radius instrument and a review checklist.

working-widgets::distinct-widget-anatomy.label: Four functional widget anatomies
working-widgets::distinct-widget-anatomy.text: Combine paper grain and edges, an oversized Aa specimen, miniature ruler ticks, a visibly changing shape and a precise completion mark. Each widget has a different anatomy while sharing one visual family.

working-widgets::sage-workbench-palette.label: White, sage and green
working-widgets::sage-workbench-palette.text: Use white and pale sage surfaces with dark green ink.

working-widgets::shared-edge-material.label: Shared tactile edges
working-widgets::shared-edge-material.text: Maintain one family of tactile edges and shadows across all four widgets.

working-widgets::working-controls.label: Working native controls
working-widgets::working-controls.text: Keep notes for the session, swap contrast colors with a computed ratio, change radius with a range input and update the completion count with checkboxes. Label session-only persistence honestly and make every control keyboard-operable.

glass-identity::identity-scale-pair.label: Hero mark beside scale proof
glass-identity::identity-scale-pair.text: Place a large translucent sculptural mark on the right of a pale green editorial page. Pair a simple left headline with progressively sized flat versions of the same mark so the relationship between identity and material is explicit.

glass-identity::folded-mark-silhouette.label: Shared folded mark silhouette
glass-identity::folded-mark-silhouette.text: Use one folded silhouette for both the large volume and crisp flat vector marks, retaining its meaningful cutouts and direction at small sizes.

glass-identity::polished-glass-volume.label: Polished refracting identity glass
glass-identity::polished-glass-volume.text: Use a clear polished volume with a restrained cool cast, tight bevels, alternating dark and bright edge intervals and softly grounded depth. Place a typographic plane genuinely behind it so refraction is visible.

glass-identity::sage-identity-palette.label: Sage-white and deep green
glass-identity::sage-identity-palette.text: Use a sage-white ground and deep green type, leaving the glass clear with only a restrained cool cast.

glass-identity::quiet-view-change.label: Quiet thickness reveal
glass-identity::quiet-view-change.text: A very quiet rotation or pointer reaction may reveal thickness. Use an actual modeled mark for a changing viewpoint and a matching composed poster fallback; keep small marks as crisp vectors.

physical-schedule::mechanical-sequence-l.label: Plan as one mechanical sequence
physical-schedule::mechanical-sequence-l.text: Present a horizontal sequence as one physical mechanical assembly on a dark blue-gray editorial stage, with a short heading above and clear stage labels below. Let the object carry the process metaphor.

physical-schedule::task-bar-geometry.label: Layered manufactured task bars
physical-schedule::task-bar-geometry.text: Set satin-metal task bars on a graphite or anodized base, with layered cap profiles, thin manufactured bevels and recessed status-light sockets.

physical-schedule::machined-schedule-mat.label: Directional machined finish
physical-schedule::machined-schedule-mat.text: Use a fine directional finish, readable direct labels, coherent status lights and contact shadows. Avoid rubber-like rounded edges and reflections that erase labels.

physical-schedule::overview-detail-view.label: Overview and finish inspection
physical-schedule::overview-detail-view.text: A quiet view change reveals the object. Inspect the finish switches from the complete plan to an intentional close view, while Show the full plan restores the overview. Preserve the selected state in matching overview and detail posters when rendering is unavailable.

iridescent-ribbon::dominant-ribbon-layou.label: Ribbon-led editorial stage
iridescent-ribbon::dominant-ribbon-layou.text: Sweep an oversized folded ribbon through a warm neutral stage beside or above a compact editorial title. Let its silhouette and negative space dominate while secondary captions and a pause control stay small.

iridescent-ribbon::continuous-folded-rib.label: Continuous folded ribbon
iridescent-ribbon::continuous-folded-rib.text: Model one continuous ribbon with smooth curvature, visible thickness and distinct front and back lighting.

iridescent-ribbon::thin-film-reflection.label: View-dependent thin-film metal
iridescent-ribbon::thin-film-reflection.text: Place thin-film metallic color on a pearl-paper ground. Iridescent hue follows angle and reflection through bright edges and darker folds rather than a static rainbow painted over a flat blob.

iridescent-ribbon::slow-material-rotatio.label: Slow reflective rotation
iridescent-ribbon::slow-material-rotatio.text: Use slow rotation to reveal the material, with immediate pause. Interactive motion uses view-dependent physical shading and GPU fallback uses a visually matched poster.

particle-assembly::particle-volume.label: Fine stable particles forming a volume
particle-assembly::particle-volume.text: Construct the subject from thousands of fine stable particles that form a volumetric surface. Let scale, overlap, density and brighter stacked edges describe depth without a mesh outline or fill, keeping the field precise and airy rather than evenly distributed screen confetti.

particle-assembly::default-composition.label: Reading column beside a particle field
particle-assembly::default-composition.text: Place a small reading column on the left and a large particle field across the right side of the page, with controls grouped below the statement and a quiet note at the lower edge. Keep the gathered subject clear of the reading column and recompose the field below the copy in portrait.

particle-assembly::default-palette.label: Blue-black with ivory-to-cyan particles
particle-assembly::default-palette.text: Use a blue-black #060a0e field with ivory-to-cyan particles, cool near-white text and restrained blue-gray supporting copy.

particle-assembly::gather-release-behavi.label: Stable gather and release motion
particle-assembly::gather-release-behavi.text: Move the same stable particles smoothly and interruptibly between an open flowing field and the gathered target. Preserve particle identity through reversals, let the released field evolve coherently and resolve the gathered state without an idle intermediate shape.

particle-assembly::library-count-target.label: Library-count numeral target
particle-assembly::library-count-target.text: Use one recognizable dimensional numeral representing the current library total, with shallow face depth rather than a flat text silhouette.

particle-assembly::plain-direction-state.label: Compact two-line direction statement
particle-assembly::plain-direction-state.text: Use a compact, large two-line sans statement with tight tracking and a quiet supporting paragraph, keeping the typographic block small enough for the particle field to dominate.

particle-assembly::gather-release-contro.label: Explicit Gather and Release controls
particle-assembly::gather-release-contro.text: Provide explicit Gather and Release buttons that retarget the current particles immediately and expose the active state to keyboard and assistive technology. The poster fallback must respond to the same choices.

material-study::fixed-study-layout.label: Fixed-pose material study
material-study::fixed-study-layout.text: Place one sculptural folded-aperture object in a quiet warm-gray studio with a large editorial headline and compact Ceramic/Metal/Glass selector. Keep geometry, camera and silhouette constant across the study.

material-study::folded-aperture.label: Shared folded aperture
material-study::folded-aperture.text: Use one folded-aperture geometry with distinct face, bevel and side readings for every material state.

material-study::three-physical-materials.label: Ceramic, metal and refracting glass
material-study::three-physical-materials.text: Give ivory ceramic a fine speckled fired body and quiet dielectric sheen; give satin metal directional reflection gradients and fine brushing; make clear glass refract the actual typographic backing plane. Avoid blacked-out metal faces and uniformly opaque-looking glass.

material-study::material-switch.label: Same-pose material selection
material-study::material-switch.text: Selection changes the actual material without moving the object or rebuilding the page. Load the detailed model once, dispose it on departure and provide matching posters for all three choices.

optical-type::type-and-lens-layout.label: Typography as optical field
optical-type::type-and-lens-layout.text: Fill an ivory optical specimen with oversized two-line black typography and overlap it with one thick oblate glass lens. Keep the enormous type and lens as the entire visual event; place two quiet captions and one compact lens-position control at the bottom.

optical-type::oversized-optical-type.label: Oversized two-line optical type
optical-type::oversized-optical-type.text: Use enormous near-black two-line typography as the sampled visual field, with thin horizontal registration lines and a small acid-yellow mark as optical reference points.

optical-type::oblate-meniscus-lens.label: Thick oblate meniscus lens
optical-type::oblate-meniscus-lens.text: Use a single thick oblate lens with a rounded meniscus-like edge, scaled roughly 1.08/.97/.44 in the showcase implementation.

optical-type::ivory-optical-palette.label: Ivory, near-black and acid yellow
optical-type::ivory-optical-palette.text: Use ivory #f5f5f0, near-black #20231f, a small acid-yellow registration mark and transparent glass with slight cyan absorption.

optical-type::physical-optical-glass.label: Physical refracting glass
optical-type::physical-optical-glass.text: Make the lens magnify and bend the letterforms behind it, with sharp elongated softbox reflections, a faint cyan rim, clear dark/light internal boundaries and a soft offset contact shadow. The showcase uses a Three.js physical glass sphere with transmission 1, roughness .015, thickness 1.25, IOR 1.48, dispersion .028 and clearcoat 1, viewed orthographically over a CanvasTexture typography plane. These are showcase implementation values, not claims about the source author.

optical-type::dragged-refraction.label: Dragged optical refraction
optical-type::dragged-refraction.text: Horizontal drag or a slider moves the lens across the words, while pointer height influences vertical position. Real refraction moves with it.

optical-type::demand-rendered-fallback.label: Demand-rendered optical states
optical-type::demand-rendered-fallback.text: Render on demand with no idle animation loop after settling. Keep three composed fallback positions and a separate portrait crop.

woven-spectrum::diagonal-weave-layout.label: Diagonal woven sweep
woven-spectrum::diagonal-weave-layout.text: Place an oversized woven sweep of narrow iridescent strips on a dark navy editorial stage. Cross the luminous bundle diagonally through the right and lower field, protect a compact left headline in stable negative space and keep small tension controls low.

woven-spectrum::many-thickened-strips.label: Twenty-two thickened ribbon strips
woven-spectrum::many-thickened-strips.text: Model 22 separately thickened ribbon strips with smooth long-wave curvature, twisting edge normals, very narrow gaps and one shared studio environment.

woven-spectrum::thin-film-weave.label: Dimensional thin-film weave
woven-spectrum::thin-film-weave.text: Use cyan, violet and pink thin-film metal over deep navy #080b16, with silver-lilac type. Fine material texture, occluded folds, crisp edge reflections and broad soft highlights make the weave dimensional. The showcase uses Three.js physical metal with roughness .14 and iridescence over 130-660nm thickness variation.

woven-spectrum::tension-geometry.label: Open-to-folded tension control
woven-spectrum::tension-geometry.text: A tension slider alters the actual weave geometry from Open through Gathered to Folded. Rebuild geometry only when the control changes and dispose replaced buffers.

woven-spectrum::restrained-reflective-mo.label: Restrained reflective orientation
woven-spectrum::restrained-reflective-mo.text: Use slow restrained orientation changes to reveal reflected light, with pause, reduced-motion support and no hidden rendering.

aperture-control::object-copy-imbalance.label: Huge aperture beside tall type
aperture-control::object-copy-imbalance.text: Let a huge physical aperture occupy the left side of a warm stone-gray page. Place tall closely set editorial type and a compact continuous control on the right, with fine labels outside the moving mechanism.

aperture-control::nine-leaf-iris.label: Nine-leaf concentric iris
aperture-control::nine-leaf-iris.text: Build nine overlapping leaves into a real adjustable circular opening, with precise concentric registration, visible thickness, fine edge bevels, engraved ticks and screws.

aperture-control::machined-iris-material.label: Ivory enclosure and brushed iris
aperture-control::machined-iris-material.text: Use an ivory enclosure, dark metal iris leaves and restrained copper-brown details. Add directional reflection on brushed surfaces; dark gaps must read as occlusion rather than a black sticker.

aperture-control::coherent-aperture-cont.label: Coherent iris control
aperture-control::coherent-aperture-cont.text: The slider and Narrow, Balanced and Open presets move all nine leaves coherently around one centre. Keep response direct and cover each preset with a poster fallback.

aperture-control::demand-rendered-mechan.label: Demand-rendered mechanism
aperture-control::demand-rendered-mechan.text: Render frames on demand as the control moves rather than maintaining unnecessary idle work.

chromatic-relief::wave-field-layout.label: Relief wave under spare type
chromatic-relief::wave-field-layout.text: Build a large architectural wave from repeated colored relief elements beneath a spare editorial heading. Protect large clear negative space between type and sculpture and keep small expression controls at the bottom.

chromatic-relief::repeated-relief-geomet.label: Phased thick relief units
chromatic-relief::repeated-relief-geomet.text: Give every relief element thickness. Use repetition, phase, spacing and depth to create the identity rather than identical flat rectangles.

chromatic-relief::plaster-cobalt-palette.label: Warm plaster and cobalt
chromatic-relief::plaster-cobalt-palette.text: Use a warm plaster ground, cobalt type and alternating saturated material faces.

chromatic-relief::edge-lit-relief.label: Edge-lit dimensional relief
chromatic-relief::edge-lit-relief.text: Use believable edge light, reflected color and coherent contact shadows to preserve separation between the thick relief units.

chromatic-relief::expression-control.label: Relief expression control
chromatic-relief::expression-control.text: Quiet, Flowing and Sculptural presets plus a continuous expression slider adjust the collective relief.

chromatic-relief::slow-rhythm-motion.label: Slow collective rhythm
chromatic-relief::slow-rhythm-motion.text: Use slow motion to alter the relief rhythm while the heading remains fixed. Provide pause, reduced motion and complete preset posters.

night-garden::full-bleed-garden.label: Full-bleed garden with protected copy
night-garden::full-bleed-garden.text: Surround a small warmly illuminated glass pavilion and its still-water reflection with a full-bleed nocturnal garden. Keep large warm-white editorial words in protected dark space on the left and quiet view controls along the bottom.

night-garden::three-depth-layers.label: Three-layer cinematic garden
night-garden::three-depth-layers.text: Compose the pavilion, its reflection and distant tree canopy as three depth layers. Include actual window mullions, thin glass reflections, roof edges, interior glow, planting at several distances and an imperfect coherent water reflection.

night-garden::night-garden-palette.label: Teal night and amber glass
night-garden::night-garden-palette.text: Use deep teal-blue #102129, warm amber interior light, silver-green foliage and creamy serif emphasis.

night-garden::atmospheric-depth.label: Soft nocturnal depth separation
night-garden::atmospheric-depth.text: Use soft atmosphere to separate distant trees without applying a generic dark overlay that erases detail.

night-garden::crop-inspection.label: Intentional garden crops
night-garden::crop-inspection.text: Whole, Glass & light and Reflections select intentional crops of the same original scene and update the caption.

night-garden::raster-reframe-behavior.label: Gentle raster reframing
night-garden::raster-reframe-behavior.text: This showcase uses detailed raster artwork with controlled CSS reframing rather than a real-time 3D garden. Keep transitions gentle and switch directly under reduced motion.

paper-theatre::book-world-layout.label: Pop-up world below editorial title
paper-theatre::book-world-layout.text: Fill the lower two thirds of a warm editorial page with an open pop-up book. Balance a large humane title above it against a three-item chapter list on the right.

paper-theatre::humane-serif-sans.label: Humane serif and sans
paper-theatre::humane-serif-sans.text: Pair humane serif and sans voices so the title belongs to the crafted editorial world.

paper-theatre::layered-paper-world.label: Detailed layered paper landscape
paper-theatre::layered-paper-world.text: Build a connected paper landscape with layered trees, a pavilion, bridge and winding stream. Give tree crowns layered cut edges, terrain stacked contours, and include turned page edges and small structural details.

paper-theatre::cream-moss-paper.label: Cream and moss paper world
paper-theatre::cream-moss-paper.text: Use warm cream #f1eadb, moss-green ink and many shades of cut paper.

paper-theatre::paper-depth.label: Grained hinged paper depth
paper-theatre::paper-depth.text: Keep visible paper grain and fold hinges that attach the world to the page. Use contact shadows between planes and coherent directional sunlight to reveal depth.

paper-theatre::chapter-reframe.label: Chapter crop selection
paper-theatre::chapter-reframe.text: Chapter choices reframe one richly rendered original image and update a caption while preserving the silhouette and book base in the complete view.

paper-theatre::static-paper-motion.label: Immediate paper crop changes
paper-theatre::static-paper-motion.text: The showcase is a raster cutout with CSS composition rather than live folding geometry. Reduced motion uses immediate crop changes.

living-terrarium::terrarium-inspection-l.label: Terrarium with editorial inspection
living-terrarium::terrarium-inspection-l.text: Let a massive thick-glass vessel containing a miniature moss garden dominate the right. Use a calm left editorial column with three numbered inspection points, and a circular loupe that lets a small detail command as much attention as the whole silhouette.

living-terrarium::miniature-garden-graph.label: Layered miniature garden
living-terrarium::miniature-garden-graph.text: Build the image from condensation beads, layered ferns, wet stone, soft moss and a small dark pool at several scales of detail.

living-terrarium::sage-garden-palette.label: Sage-gray and dark green
living-terrarium::sage-garden-palette.text: Use a sage-gray ground, dark green type and natural wet greens within the vessel.

living-terrarium::thick-terrarium-glass.label: Thick distorting terrarium glass
living-terrarium::thick-terrarium-glass.text: Use thick clear glass that distorts the miniature scene at its edge and carries large soft reflections.

living-terrarium::canopy-light.label: Canopy-penetrating light
living-terrarium::canopy-light.text: Let light penetrate the canopy and cast contact shadows on the rocks.

living-terrarium::registered-loupe.label: Registered magnifying loupe
living-terrarium::registered-loupe.text: Glass & water, Canopy & light and Stone & moss move a true magnifying crop to the corresponding feature while preserving pixel alignment after resize.

red-chamber::chamber-hero-layout.label: Chrome form in a vermilion chamber
red-chamber::chamber-hero-layout.text: Fill the frame with a vermilion chamber around one large polished sculptural chrome form. Reserve a clear left zone for oversized warm-white words and use one compact detail action.

red-chamber::warm-serif-sans.label: Oversized warm mixed type
red-chamber::warm-serif-sans.text: Use oversized warm-white serif and sans words in the protected left reading zone.

red-chamber::red-silver-palette.label: Deep red, silver and cream
red-chamber::red-silver-palette.text: Use deep red #640f12, scarlet velvet, mirror-like silver and creamy type.

red-chamber::chrome-velvet-contrast.label: Mirror chrome against velvet
red-chamber::chrome-velvet-contrast.text: Give velvet directional pile, deep soft folds and diffuse red bounce. Give chrome sharp highlight ribbons, dark reflected bands and curved distortion of the red environment, with contact shadows attaching hard form to soft ground.

red-chamber::detail-reframe.label: Installation-to-material detail
red-chamber::detail-reframe.text: Look closer changes between the entire installation and an intimate material view, updating the state label.

red-chamber::gentle-raster-reframe.label: Gentle cinematic reframe
red-chamber::gentle-raster-reframe.text: Gently reframe the same authored raster image and use an immediate reduced-motion version. The scene is not a real-time reflective room.

specimen-cabinet::cabinet-layout.label: Six-specimen editorial cabinet
specimen-cabinet::cabinet-layout.text: Use a carefully photographed cabinet of six material specimens as the main field, balanced by restrained editorial type and a small selected-specimen description.

specimen-cabinet::material-collection.label: Coherent material collection
specimen-cabinet::material-collection.text: Treat the grid as an actual collection in which each object has its own surface vocabulary, coherent scale, contact shadow, fine edge and enough resolution for microstructure comparison.

specimen-cabinet::museum-labels.label: Quiet museum-drawer labels
specimen-cabinet::museum-labels.text: Keep labels quiet and precise, like a museum drawer.

specimen-cabinet::six-surface-vocabulari.label: Six distinct surface vocabularies
specimen-cabinet::six-surface-vocabulari.text: Combine warm chalk, stone, glass, metal and softer organic textures under one consistent studio light.

specimen-cabinet::specimen-dialog.label: Keyboard-equivalent specimen detail
specimen-cabinet::specimen-dialog.text: Each specimen button opens a large detail dialog with a material name and specific description. Escape and close return to the cabinet; touch and keyboard inspection are equivalent.

contact-sheet::film-editor-layout.label: Film-editor contact sheet
contact-sheet::film-editor-layout.text: Balance large serif/sans words on the left with one large selected photograph bounded by perforated film rails. Present six richly different thumbnails in a bottom strip, keeping caption and selected-frame count aligned with the main image.

contact-sheet::mixed-editorial-type.label: Large mixed editorial type
contact-sheet::mixed-editorial-type.text: Use large soft-ivory serif and sans words with quiet captions and precise frame counts.

contact-sheet::six-image-collection.label: Six materially diverse frames
contact-sheet::six-image-collection.text: Contrast chrome on velvet, a night garden, paper, glass with foliage, studio materials and engraved ink without forcing them through one color filter.

contact-sheet::charcoal-film-palette.label: Charcoal film and acid green
contact-sheet::charcoal-film-palette.text: Use charcoal-green #191c1b, soft ivory type and one pale acid-green accent.

contact-sheet::restrained-film-frames.label: Restrained film borders
contact-sheet::restrained-film-frames.text: Give image frames restrained borders and precise gutters rather than ornamental card chrome.

contact-sheet::select-and-reorder.label: Select, inspect and reorder frames
contact-sheet::select-and-reorder.text: Selecting a thumbnail updates the main image, caption and selected state. Left and right controls reorder the selected frame and disable at either end; the main image opens a detail dialog. Preserve focus during reordering and report position accessibly.

auric-orbit::mineral-orbit-layout.label: Monumental mineral with spare copy
auric-orbit::mineral-orbit-layout.text: Let one oversized irregular mineral orb dominate a blue-black stage, balanced by a wide spare editorial statement at left, quiet negative space and material controls at the lower edge. Wrap two very fine orbital arcs and tiny scattered specks around the silhouette.

auric-orbit::rough-mineral-orb.label: Irregular relief-cut mineral orb
auric-orbit::rough-mineral-orb.text: Use a large irregular orb with actual displaced geometric relief, fine ridges and occluded valleys rather than a smooth sphere.

auric-orbit::warm-editorial-contrast.label: Neutral sans with humane serif emphasis
auric-orbit::warm-editorial-contrast.text: Set the large statement in a neutral sans with warm text and humane serif emphasis, keeping the type spare enough to preserve the mineral orb's hierarchy.

auric-orbit::charcoal-gold-mineral.label: Charcoal mineral with gold veins
auric-orbit::charcoal-gold-mineral.text: Build a charcoal mineral body with muted metallic inclusions, narrow warm-gold veins and tiny granular detail. Give veins and stone different roughness and metallic response; do not replace them with uniform emission or a smooth gradient.

auric-orbit::raking-studio-light.label: Raking studio light over relief
auric-orbit::raking-studio-light.text: Use coherent studio light that catches ridges, leaves valleys dark and lets the inner veins read as light beneath matter.

auric-orbit::mineral-state-motion.label: Stateful rotating mineral surface
auric-orbit::mineral-state-motion.text: Mineral, Awakened and Glacial are three actual material/light states. Inner light changes vein glow; slow rotation and fine-pointer movement reveal the relief. Pause and reduced motion retain a composed object.
