camera-obscura::technical-workbench-layo.label: Camera inspection workbench
camera-obscura::technical-workbench-layo.text: Balance a large inspectable camera on a pale technical studio with a compact top-left statement, narrow right specimen column and bottom inspection strip. Reserve ample object area, a visible grounding shadow and spare technical annotations.

camera-obscura::mechanical-camera-assemb.label: Layered mechanical camera assembly
camera-obscura::mechanical-camera-assemb.text: Model coherent lens, body and internal subassemblies with concentric barrel lips, knurling, fasteners, top dials, circuitry, iris leaves and registered lens layers. Contact interfaces and edge bevels make the relationships plausible; raw part count is not the quality target.

camera-obscura::camera-material-system.label: Graphite, metal and green optics
camera-obscura::camera-material-system.text: Use a graphite body, silver and warm-metal rings, fine grip texture, translucent green-tinted optics and engraved-looking labels. Distinguish rough body surfaces, metal edges and transmissive glass.

camera-obscura::exploded-inspection.label: Assembled, exploded and inside views
camera-obscura::exploded-inspection.text: Assembled, Exploded and Inside expose real configurations. One separation scalar moves coherent subassemblies along the lens/body axis, while restrained pointer motion changes the inspection angle without losing registration.

plasma-study::crisp-spherical-silhouette.label: Crisp sphere-like optical silhouette
plasma-study::crisp-spherical-silhouette.text: Use one crisp fixed spherical limb with fine field detail compressed toward its edge.

plasma-study::lagoon-mineral-palette.label: Blue-green, pale gold and violet
plasma-study::lagoon-mineral-palette.text: Combine warm ivory #ebebe1, deep green and muted green-gray with dark blue-green regions, pale golden filaments and subtle violet clouding.

plasma-study::procedural-optical-field.label: Dense procedural mineral field
plasma-study::procedural-optical-field.text: Construct an internal-looking projected optical field with original procedural turbulence, coherent density and fine filamentary detail. It is a procedural surface study, not arbitrary DOM refraction or a measured volumetric simulation.

plasma-study::default-editorial-stage.label: Large orb on an airy editorial stage
plasma-study::default-editorial-stage.text: Place one very large focal graphic in the main field, with a quiet editorial statement at left, ample open space and compact atmosphere, excitation and pause controls along the lower edge.

plasma-study::default-field-behavior.label: Slow coherent field evolution
plasma-study::default-field-behavior.text: Evolve the internal procedural field slowly and coherently inside a fixed boundary. Reduced motion, paused playback and matching posters retain an intentional composed state.

plasma-study::sans-serif-form-statement.label: Large sans statement with serif emphasis
plasma-study::sans-serif-form-statement.text: Set a large, tightly tracked two-line sans statement with one restrained Instrument Serif emphasis, a small mono eyebrow and a quiet supporting paragraph.

plasma-study::view-sensitive-sphere-ligh.label: Directional sheen and cyan edge light
plasma-study::view-sensitive-sphere-ligh.text: Use directional form light, a tight view-sensitive pale sheen, a restrained cyan edge contribution and a narrow pale boundary highlight so the focal surface stays dimensional without turning into a bright white rim.

plasma-study::atmosphere-excitation-cont.label: Atmosphere, excitation and orientation controls
plasma-study::atmosphere-excitation-cont.text: Lagoon, Violet and Ember select distinct palettes; Excitation changes luminous energy; pointer position shifts field orientation; and Pause or Resume controls the evolution. Keep every control keyboard and touch operable.

phosphor-field::display-field-layout.label: One broad signal display
phosphor-field::display-field-layout.text: Stretch one broad luminous display plate beneath a short technical heading on a nearly black ground. Keep small mode and density controls below the field instead of enclosing it in a generic metrics dashboard.

phosphor-field::phosphor-cell-graphics.label: Signal sampled through stable cells
phosphor-field::phosphor-cell-graphics.text: Render a recognizable waveform, columns or orbit signal through tiny stable cells, preserving the visible unlit matrix, individual cell edges, dark gutters and a slight perspective skew. The graphic must read as one signal at distance and structured cells close up.

phosphor-field::green-cyan-emission.label: Cool green-to-cyan phosphor
phosphor-field::green-cyan-emission.text: Use cool green-to-cyan emission over near-black, with restrained glow and darker unlit cells. Keep a strong separation between fixed white labels and the luminous field.

phosphor-field::registered-signal-motion.label: Registered cells with evolving signal
phosphor-field::registered-signal-motion.text: Evolve the signal from one shared clock while every cell and reading anchor remains registered. Wave, Columns and Orbit must produce distinctly different geometry; density changes the matrix. Pause and reduced motion hold a composed state.

phosphor-field::technical-type-default.label: Technical serif and mono signal type
phosphor-field::technical-type-default.text: Use a large technical statement with restrained serif emphasis, plus a small mono eyebrow and exact fixed labels that stay registered while the signal changes.

silver-tide::reflective-horizon-layout.label: Meditative horizon over moving water
silver-tide::reflective-horizon-layout.text: Fill the page with a wide dark sea beneath a sparse meditative heading. Preserve a coherent low horizon and quiet upper reading area, balanced by a small right note and bottom light and pace controls.

silver-tide::layered-reflective-water.label: Layered reflective dark water
silver-tide::layered-reflective-water.text: Layer long swells and finer ripples into one continuous blue-black water surface with sharp silver reflection fragments and darker troughs. Avoid large blurry sine bumps.

silver-tide::silver-afterglow-light.label: Silver and amber horizon light
silver-tide::silver-afterglow-light.text: Use cool silver specular fragments by default; the Afterglow state adds warm amber light while preserving the same wave structure and horizon.

silver-tide::authored-tide-playback.label: Deterministic 16-second tide loop
silver-tide::authored-tide-playback.text: Use a deterministic authored 16-second wave loop with intentional hover or explicit playback. Pace changes playback rate; Silver and Afterglow select matched films. Pause on hover leave and hidden tabs, and keep keyboard playback available.

cloud-chamber::architectural-opening-lay.label: Monumental arch with anchored focal object
cloud-chamber::architectural-opening-lay.text: Raise a monumental limestone and bronze arch above a reflective pool and walkway, with a live optical sphere anchored inside its opening. Reserve quiet sky for large dark architectural type on wide screens and use a separately composed portrait image region to protect the words.

cloud-chamber::arch-pool-environment.label: Layered architectural landscape
cloud-chamber::arch-pool-environment.text: Author a connected environment of porous stone, warm bronze edges, cool sky, atmospheric distance, a scale-giving walkway and water that reflects the mass above it.

cloud-chamber::ringed-optical-sphere.label: Clear sphere with fine metallic rings
cloud-chamber::ringed-optical-sphere.text: Anchor one thick clear glass sphere with very fine metallic rings inside the architectural opening, preserving a sharp spherical boundary and internal reflected structure.

cloud-chamber::matched-environment-glass.label: Environment-matched optical glass
cloud-chamber::matched-environment-glass.text: Make the sphere's reflection and lighting agree with the pictured landscape. Avoid an unrelated rectangular studio reflection that makes the live object feel pasted in.

cloud-chamber::optical-centre-motion.label: Motion held inside the optical centre
cloud-chamber::optical-centre-motion.text: Clear, Warm and Cool vary the optical centre. Slow ring movement and subtle pointer response reveal it while architecture and copy remain still.

ember-portrait::protected-portrait-layou.label: Oversized portrait with protected copy
ember-portrait::protected-portrait-layou.text: Let an oversized synthetic portrait occupy the right and most of the vertical field while strong uppercase type sits in clear darker space at left. Finish with a quiet material caption and three inspection views. On mobile, recompose around the face and protect a lower message region.

ember-portrait::authored-synthetic-portr.label: Detailed synthetic object portrait
ember-portrait::authored-synthetic-portr.text: Use a richly authored object portrait with an amber curved visor, complex face enclosure, tiny mesh, gaskets, braiding, fasteners and subtle surface wear. Preserve character and detail at several scales rather than producing a glossy toy.

ember-portrait::graphite-amber-materials.label: Graphite ceramic, dark metal and amber glass
ember-portrait::graphite-amber-materials.text: Combine matte graphite ceramic, layered dark metal and curved amber glass. Give the face and enclosure different roughness, with long reflected light shapes and warm internal glints for depth.

ember-portrait::authored-crop-inspection.label: Portrait, visor and mechanism crops
ember-portrait::authored-crop-inspection.text: Portrait, The visor and The mechanism select deliberate crops and matching explanatory captions. Subtle pointer reframing may support inspection, but a raster asset does not promise unrestricted orbit or moving facial geometry.

terrain-interface::layered-feature-layou.label: Choice rail, product frame and terrain
terrain-interface::layered-feature-layou.text: On a warm light feature surface, place a concise heading and three-item choice rail at left, a considered miniature collection interface at right and rich coral terrain across the foreground. Let terrain overlap only the nonessential base of the product frame.

terrain-interface::fibrous-coral-terrain.label: Coral suede-fiber terrain
terrain-interface::fibrous-coral-terrain.text: Build coral-orange hills from fine suede-like fibers, uneven crests, self-shadowed folds and warm light. Contrast their granular softness with precise interface planes; a flat orange curve is not equivalent.

terrain-interface::warm-collection-palet.label: Cream, charcoal and coral
terrain-interface::warm-collection-palet.text: Use cream and white-to-ivory interface planes, warm charcoal ink and coral-orange terrain, with a small tactile mark that echoes the foreground color.

terrain-interface::miniature-collection-.label: Precise layered collection preview
terrain-interface::miniature-collection-.text: Create a legible original miniature collection interface with quiet rules, tabular details, layered window edges and meaningful surface specimens rather than copied customer data.

terrain-interface::feature-preview-selec.label: Choices update a visible preview
terrain-interface::feature-preview-selec.text: Each feature choice updates the collection title, message and visual surface specimens, with a stable active rail marker. Keep operation available to keyboard and touch, and recompose preview and terrain independently on phones.

sunlit-field::illustrated-atlas-layout.label: Editorial type over a connected landscape
sunlit-field::illustrated-atlas-layout.text: Place a large editorial serif statement in pale sky above one connected agricultural valley. Complete the page with small inspection links and a restrained compass-like detail, while preserving clear reading space in every crop.

sunlit-field::engraved-valley-illustrati.label: Multi-depth engraved agricultural valley
sunlit-field::engraved-valley-illustrati.text: Draw engraved clouds, layered mountains, fields, water, a pavilion and foreground grasses as one richly observed landscape. Use several scales of line density, stipple, material texture and fine small structures to establish foreground, middle distance and horizon depth.

sunlit-field::golden-printed-palette.label: Golden paper with olive and teal ink
sunlit-field::golden-printed-palette.text: Use warm golden paper, olive ink, dusty teal distance and ochre highlights, with subtle printed irregularity.

sunlit-field::printed-editorial-type.label: Serif type belonging to the printed world
sunlit-field::printed-editorial-type.text: Use a large editorial serif voice whose weight, scale and texture belong to the illustrated printed world rather than a generic SaaS header.

sunlit-field::landscape-crop-inspection.label: Valley, water and shelter inspection
sunlit-field::landscape-crop-inspection.text: The valley, The water and The shelter select intentional crops and captions from one original scene. Keep movement gentle, remove travel under reduced motion and leave the landscape fully composed at rest.

chamber-control::continuous-instrument-g.label: Dense continuous instrument console
chamber-control::continuous-instrument-g.text: Set a disciplined dark console beneath a technical heading. Fit a large response plot, physical knobs, illumination switch, state selector and distribution meter into distinct module shapes on one continuous grid.

chamber-control::functional-module-graph.label: Different evidence in every module
chamber-control::functional-module-graph.text: Give each module useful distinct anatomy: a response plot, setpoints, radial ticks, modes and distribution evidence. Use honest units or explicitly relative values rather than decorative pseudo-telemetry.

chamber-control::machined-dark-console.label: Machined anthracite instrument panels
chamber-control::machined-dark-console.text: Use anthracite-green planes, crisp inset borders, restrained bevels, directional surface light and machined knob faces, with tiny warm-orange indicators and tabular or mono numbers.

chamber-control::operable-local-study.label: Controls drive a visible local model
chamber-control::operable-local-study.text: Excitation, damping and angle update the visible local model and curve; illumination and character controls expose actual state changes. Every control has native keyboard input.

quiet-frequency::playable-rack-layout.label: Editorial listening rack
quiet-frequency::playable-rack-layout.text: Pair an expressive editorial heading and explicit listening action with a broad scope and four carefully fitted modules. Make the waveform the largest evidence region; use knobs, an echo diagram and level strips for finer detail.

quiet-frequency::coherent-audio-modules.label: Functional audio evidence modules
quiet-frequency::coherent-audio-modules.text: Use waveform, filter, echo and output modules that share a visual language while each explains different information. Keep displayed metrics registered as signal data changes.

quiet-frequency::quiet-dark-rack-materia.label: Green-black rack with warm hardware
quiet-frequency::quiet-dark-rack-materia.text: Use deep green-black panels, warm silver and ivory, fine panel rims, restrained status lights, concentric dial markings and quiet mono labels.

quiet-frequency::opt-in-audio-instrument.label: Opt-in Web Audio instrument
quiet-frequency::opt-in-audio-instrument.text: Start listening creates a local Web Audio tone. Frequency, filter openness, echo and level change the sound, and the scope reads the analyser. Sound never starts on page appearance; controls remain keyboard operable.

common-clock::fanout-drawing-layout.label: Editorial explanation beside fanout drawing
common-clock::fanout-drawing-layout.text: Balance a left editorial explanation with a large light drawing sheet. One small dimensional lead object dispatches to four distinct process specimens through curved routes, then resolves into a merged result and one progress strip.

common-clock::routed-process-diagram.label: Coherent routed process specimens
common-clock::routed-process-diagram.text: Use real curved vector routes, small colored packets, consistent projection, different internal specimen drawings and readable status. Avoid generic connected icons.

common-clock::warm-technical-sheet.label: Warm paper with restrained signals
common-clock::warm-technical-sheet.text: Use warm paper, precise green-gray lines, pale modeled node faces, small specimen labels and a restrained family of signal colors.

common-clock::single-clock-sequence.label: One clock for dispatch, work and return
common-clock::single-clock-sequence.text: Coordinate dispatch, work and return with one six-second logical clock. Move packets on actual SVG route geometry and update status only at semantic stages. Watch and Stop are explicit, the completed frame stays useful, and reduced motion presents completion immediately.

vector-foundry::editorial-blueprint-layo.label: Serif editorial sheet with wave specimen
vector-foundry::editorial-blueprint-layo.text: Balance a large narrow serif statement with an isometric ruled wave sheet on a paper-and-blueprint surface. Frame it with a fine ground projection, specimen index, measured-looking annotation and small seal.

vector-foundry::coherent-ruled-surface.label: One equation for contour and ruling
vector-foundry::coherent-ruled-surface.text: Construct the wave from crisp continuous vector paths in a carefully proportioned 2:1-like isometric projection. The outer contour and internal rulings must derive from the same parametric surface; detail is structural rather than textured 3D decoration.

vector-foundry::paper-blueprint-palette.label: Warm paper and blue-green line ranks
vector-foundry::paper-blueprint-palette.text: Use warm paper with muted blue-green line ranks, one restrained accent and enough contrast to separate contour, ruling, ground and annotation.

vector-foundry::parametric-wave-control.label: Flat, Ripple and Surge amplitude control
vector-foundry::parametric-wave-control.text: Flat, Ripple and Surge select wave character; a continuous height control changes amplitude. Native SVG paths derive from one surface without requiring a 3D library. One phase drives motion and stops when hidden or reduced.

thermal-type::heat-source-layout.label: Technical type beside a physical heat source
thermal-type::heat-source-layout.text: Place a large luminous heat chamber at right on a cool gray page and bold technical type in the quiet left region. The amber opening and concentric hardware must physically explain the localized shimmer in the nearby words.

thermal-type::industrial-heat-chamber.label: Titanium and glowing ceramic chamber
thermal-type::industrial-heat-chamber.text: Build a dark titanium chamber with radial fins, fine fasteners, polished ring edges and a glowing striated ceramic opening.

thermal-type::bounded-heat-refraction.label: Bounded directional heat refraction
thermal-type::bounded-heat-refraction.text: Carry one bounded optical field from the aperture through the adjacent image and technical headline with coherent direction and falloff. Keep the text block fixed while local details refract, and retain a crisp reduced-motion state.

thermal-type::resting-thermal-motion.label: Heat visible in the resting state
thermal-type::resting-thermal-motion.text: Start heat on entry without hover. Pointer presence may increase it slightly; Pause heat freezes the current field and Resume continues. Recompute the source from the actual image crop on resize and stop hidden or offscreen work.

morph-study::mint-particle-layout.label: Editorial heading beside a particle structure
morph-study::mint-particle-layout.text: On a warm mint field, place a large expressive heading beside a clear three-dimensional particle structure, with compact shape and formation controls below. Give the point cloud enough area, density and contrast to balance the type.

morph-study::authored-particle-targets.label: Stable particles resolving authored geometry
morph-study::authored-particle-targets.text: Use stable point identities sampled into recognizable authored target geometries. Let distribution, overlap and density describe depth; keep text outside the rendering layer and avoid diffuse dust that loses the chosen shape.

morph-study::deep-green-mint-palette.label: Deep green points on pale mint
morph-study::deep-green-mint-palette.text: Use fine deep-green points on a pale warm-mint ground, with enough contrast for the resting target at mobile size.

morph-study::stable-particle-retargeting.label: Interruptible geometry retargeting
morph-study::stable-particle-retargeting.text: Sphere, Current and Loop move the same particles among authored targets with restrained rotation; Formation changes how tightly they resolve. Retarget from current positions, preserve stable identities, and provide an intentional completed state for pause and reduced motion.

morph-study::editorial-type-default.label: Expressive serif particle-study type
morph-study::editorial-type-default.text: Use an expressive editorial heading with Instrument Serif emphasis, balanced by a sans base and quiet precise controls, labels and supporting copy.
